system.details:
Once a deck-mounted weapon, now handheld though equally potent. Deals high-impact LR Blast damage as standard. When you choose this aspect it gains a base frame:

  • Hullbreaker - Increase impact when targeting ships and structures,
  • Mazengara - Increase impact when targeting leviathans and protoleviathans,
  • Scattering Storm - Your shots affect multiple nearby targets.

a sketchy alteration:
  • Hazardcrank - Mark while attacking to increase the cannon's impact against any target,
  • Adaptive Loader - Consume a resource to temporarily change the cannon's damage type to one tied to the resource until the end of the scene,
  • Explosive Exhaust - The cannon's exhaust ports can increase the impact of leaps and dashes.

and a serious flaw:
  • Dead Weight - You take a cut on all actions made to jump, climb, or move at speed,
  • Ammunition Jam - A disaster while firing jams the weapon until end of scene, making LR attacks impossible. Burn to unjam early,
  • Wild Thunder - You can't use whispers in any way until end of scene after firing the cannon,
  • Barrel-Parasite - Consume a piece of salvage at the end of any scene in which the cannon is fired. If you can't, burn a box.
